units.rawText: Comrade, do you still remember? Back then, when we... No, it's nothing.
units.displayText: Comrade, do you still remember? Back then, when we... No, it's nothing.

spans.text: Comrade, do you still remember? Back then, when we... No, it's nothing.

units.rawText: I was simply recalling what you told me in the other world... Something that only one person can clearly remember, and which does not exist in the memories of anyone else... Truly, that is a painful thing.
units.displayText: I was simply recalling what you told me in the other world... Something that only one person can clearly remember, and which does not exist in the memories of anyone else... Truly, that is a painful thing.

spans.text: I was simply recalling what you told me in the other world... Something that only one person can clearly remember, and which does not exist in the memories of anyone else... Truly, that is a painful thing.

units.rawText: (Sigh) Such is the lot of the lonely observer's life, I guess.
units.displayText: (Sigh) Such is the lot of the lonely observer's life, I guess.

spans.text: (Sigh) Such is the lot of the lonely observer's life, I guess.

units.rawText: Still, at least I am no longer alone in this place. Let us bear the memories of this world line together. Isn't that right... my comrade?
